title: Zelenskyy says US has set June deadline for Ukraine-Russia peace deal
summary: Ukrainian president says Trump administration has proposed to host next round of trilateral talks in US Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said the US has given Ukraine and Russia yet another deadline to reach a peace settlement, and is now proposing the war should end by June. The Ukrainian president also told reporters that both sides had been invited to further talks next week. Zelenskyy said the Trump administration “will probably put pressure” on Ukraine and Russia to end the war by the beginning of the summer. “They say they want to get everything done by June,” he said. “ They will do everything to end the war and they want a clear schedule of all events.” Continue reading...

title: Wild Week of Trading Leaves Pockmarks Across US Equity Landscape
summary: Precious metals memed out, Bitcoin flamed out and the labor market looks like it’s petering out. None of it started in the equities market, but together it was enough — along with a reckoning for software firms — to shake the foundation of an AI-driven bull run.
